title: Turn Request
description: Inbound submission of a turn. Every field is untrusted content. Origin is deliberately absent: it is stamped by the server from the authenticated connection and can never be supplied by a caller.

project.description: Absolute project path the caller means. Resolution is exact-match; the server never infers a session from recency or idleness.

sessionId.description: Existing session to continue. Omitted means create for this project when creation is permitted.

prompt.description: Untrusted text. Scanned by the security boundary before it can become a turn.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeated key returns the original turnId and starts nothing.
